exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Receiving (Noun wo morau)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 名詞＋をもらう matches "Receiving (Noun wo morau)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 名詞＋をもらう.
exercises.explanation: Expresses receiving something; the receiver uses noun + をもらう.
